queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: Keywords to search for, one per line ("kubernetes", "rust async"). Leave empty to just browse a category (e.g. the front page) using the filters below.

category.title: Category
category.description: Limit to a Hacker News category (stories only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Optional: only items by this Hacker News username (e.g. "pg").

minPoints.title: Minimum points
minPoints.description: Only items with at least this many points. 0 = no minimum.

minComments.title: Minimum comments
minComments.description: Stories only: at least this many comments. 0 = no minimum.

sinceDays.title: Posted within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only items from the last N days. 0 = no date limit.

maxPerQuery.title: Results per search
maxPerQuery.description: How many items to return per search term (or per category browse).

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
